meta.task: L2-0 PSD attribute-universe census (precondition for projection-wave Lane 3)

e_d6_number.note: The pg mirror admits only mapped-commodity rows, so the admission number is rows_in_scope_commodities pre-explode; if the mirror is keyed by leviathan_slug (as silver is) the fan-out figure applies instead.

a_row_totals.verdict: Kept/dropped CONFIRMED exactly. The 1,899,303 total is the POST-commodity-filter in-scope subtotal, not the object's row count; the object carries 2092687 rows, 193384 of which are unmapped-commodity rows the producer drops at step 3.

b_area_planted.verdict: ABSENT from the PSD bulk file -- settled by measurement
b_area_planted.contradiction_resolution: There was never a data contradiction: it was a mis-read of the source doc. projection_census.md:931 asserts Area Planted as a column of the 'PSD Data Statistics' balance-sheet tables printed INSIDE GAIN attache PDFs, and the same sentence states outright that the attache numbers are NOT in the PSD bulk file. It never claimed the PSD bulk file carries Area Planted. The 47-label roster and line 931 are both correct and describe different objects.
b_area_planted.where_area_planted_actually_lives: GAIN attache PDF balance-sheet tables (unstructured text only). projection_census.md:931 records that bronze/production/ has no source=usda_gain and silver/ has no GAIN table, so there is NO numeric lane for it anywhere in the estate.

prior_roster_reconciliation.prior_claim: 8 of 58 attributes are kept; 923,165 rows dropped across 47 labels
prior_roster_reconciliation.verdict: Both are right on different bases. The prior doc's 58 = labels carrying >=1 in-scope row; its 47 = the unserved subset of those. This census's 69/58 is on the whole object. The one real correction: 11 labels survive step 6, not 8 -- the three slug-keyed remap sources are accepted too.

head_unit_survives_commodity_filter.finding: The producer's _UNIT_FACTOR note claims (1000 HEAD) rides only the two animal-numbers codes that _PSD_UNMAPPED_CODES refuses. Measured, 'Cows In Milk' (id 6) rides the MAPPED commodity 'Dairy, Milk, Fluid', so its rows clear step 3 and are stopped only by the step-6 attribute filter.
head_unit_survives_commodity_filter.severity: documentation defect, not a live bug -- nothing is mis-served today
